text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're a few days from the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling good again… Actually, I might even be in better shape than before my injury.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But… the time it took to confirm that—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, girlie! What's the dealio? ♪ Has something got you down?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well then, you're lucky that your raddest, baddest upperclassmen just happened to pass by! What's eating at you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: M-Maruzen?! What are you—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Lemme guess—you're worried because you're jumping right back into the racing world without a parachute, riiight?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's see if we can't turn that frown upside-down with a pair run! If nothing else, you'll get a solid idea of your current condish.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really? You'd do that for me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's all good! ♪ I'd do anything for my sweet little Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you for running with me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …I'm floored over here. You must've worked your butt off to get back into such awesome shape.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You've done so well, Chiyo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Well, I've got people waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: People who taught me—through their running—that limits can be surpassed over and over.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: They have faith that I'll make my return to the turf.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: They're my rivals. They mean the world to me, and there's no one else like them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I have done well, then… I think it's thanks to them.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you've got some totally sweet rivals. …I'm actually getting a little jelly here! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: H-huh?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm just pulling your leg! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen… Go run like there's no tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And remember to have fun racing against your rivals! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …! Yeah! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're in for another crazy good Takarazuka Kinen this year! Hmm, I'm guessing it'll probably be Mejiro Ardan or Yaeno Muteki in first.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Don't forget that Inari One's running, though. With all the hype she's been generating, anything could happen!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh, good point! This race's gonna be close for sure. Plus, there's that one other racer—y'know, the one who announced she was aiming for the Takarazuka Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm Sakura Chiyono O, and today, I'm going to blow the competition away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We finally meet again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet… while it's fresh. Sorry to have kept you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not at all… I'm just truly delighted that you've made it here today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You appear to be in excellent form.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I cannot wait to compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Today's going to mark more than just my return to racing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It's going to be the day I surpass my limits and defeat you both!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Spoken like a true rival of ours.
Whoa there! This is quite the lineup we've got here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I know it's kinda rude of me to come barging in on this emotional reunion… but I saw you all raring to go and just couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Inari has recently and rapidly made a name for herself as one of the great racers of our time, alongside Oguri and Creek.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You guys look like you're about to put up a real fight. It's gettin' me all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll take down all of ya. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Her claims are more than mere bravado. There's an unusual intensity about her that's similar to that of Oguri's!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (However…)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Right back at you. Upon my name as Yaeno Muteki, I will face you with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Don't count me out either! Underestimate me and I'll make you eat your words!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Not a single one of us is about to back down. On the contrary, we're brimming with joy at the prospect of fresh and fierce competition!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let's have ourselves the race of a lifetime. But do bear in mind, I shall be the one to emerge victorious!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Well, well! You're all packing more pluck than I'd imagined!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's set the Hanshin racecourse ablaze with our fireworks!
